text: language English<asr_text>Hi, how’re you doing?
language English<asr_text>Terrible.
language English<asr_text>Oh, what’s the matter?
language English<asr_text>I’ve got a fever and really a bad headache.
language English<asr_text>Oh, that’s too bad. Why don’t you take some aspirin?
language English<asr_text>I’ve already tried some but it didn’t help.
language English<asr_text>Well, it’s necessary for you to see a doctor.
language English<asr_text>Yeah, I guess I should.
language English<asr_text>Well, you’d better get some rest.
language English<asr_text>Thank you very much.
language English<asr_text>Bye.
language English<asr_text>That'll be twelve dollars and ninty-five cents, please.
language English<asr_text>Can you break a one-hundred dollar bill?
language English<asr_text>Oh, you don't have anything smaller?
language English<asr_text>No, I'm sorry. That's all I have. Unless you take a credit card.
language English<asr_text>Oh, sure. Credit card is fine.
language English<asr_text>Hello, Jim. Where are you going?
language English<asr_text>To the cinema. Umm what about coming with me?
language English<asr_text>No, thanks. I'm going home. My husband's expecting me.
language English<asr_text>What a pity. I believe it's a very good film.
language English<asr_text>Do you go to the cinema a lot?
language English<asr_text>Once a week. Most nights I sit at home and watch telly.
language English<asr_text>Do you know what's on tonight by any chance?
language English<asr_text>No, I'm sorry I don't. I never read the papers till I get home.
language English<asr_text>Oh, I see. By the way, where are you going for your holidays this year?
language English<asr_text>I don't know yet. My wife's going to her mother's for a couple of weeks. She Livesay the sea, you know.
language English<asr_text>Oh, does she? That's convenient.
language English<asr_text>Yes, but I want to go to the country.
language English<asr_text>Don't you like the sea?
language English<asr_text>Yes, very much. But I need peace and quiet when I'm on holiday. What are coughing to do?
language English<asr_text>I'm going to stay at home.
language English<asr_text>Aren't you going to have a holiday abroad this year?
language English<asr_text>No, I want to buy a car, and that's going to take every penny I've got.
language English<asr_text>Do you develop films here?
language English<asr_text>Yes, we shall. What size do you like?
language English<asr_text>Well, the four to six is fine.
language English<asr_text>Which do you prefer, color or black and white?
language English<asr_text>Umm…. The last one is black and white, all the rest should need color.
language English<asr_text>OK.
language English<asr_text>I hope they will come out well. When should I pick them up?
language English<asr_text>They will be ready at noon tomorrow. Each negative develops one print, right?
language English<asr_text>Yes, it is. And develop them as glossy as possible.
language English<asr_text>No problem. Do you need another film?
language English<asr_text>Yes, a roll of Kodak film please.
language English<asr_text>It is totally twenty dollars including the deposit for films.
language English<asr_text>Good morning, Loans.
language English<asr_text>Good morning, Mr. Smith.
language English<asr_text>I would like to compliment you on your diligence.
language English<asr_text>Well, thank you, Mr. Smith. But I was just doing my job.
language English<asr_text>Yes. And we're proud of you, Loans.
language English<asr_text>It's nice of you to say so.
language English<asr_text>Umm excuse me.
language English<asr_text>Hello sir, may I help you?
language English<asr_text>Yes. Can I see that T-shirt on the top shelf please?
language English<asr_text>Sure. Here it is.
language English<asr_text>How much does it cost?
language English<asr_text>Fifty dollars.
language English<asr_text>Fifty dollars. That's too much.
language English<asr_text>How about this one? It's on sale for only thirty five dollars.
language English<asr_text>I don't like that one.
language English<asr_text>How about the one next to the black gloves? It's very similar to the one you like.
language English<asr_text>That's nice. How much is it?
language English<asr_text>Thirty dollars.
language English<asr_text>That'll be fine.
language English<asr_text>Is this color OK, or would you like a different color?
language English<asr_text>That blue one's fine.
language English<asr_text>Do you need any more of these shirts?
language English<asr_text>Yes.
language English<asr_text>How many do you want?
language English<asr_text>I'll take two more, a red one and a white one.
language English<asr_text>What certificates of technical qualification have you got?
language English<asr_text>Umm I have got a computer engineer's qualification certificate.
language English<asr_text>Have you worked in a computer company before?
language English<asr_text>Oh, yes, I have. I worked part-time as a typewriter in a computer company when I was at college.
language English<asr_text>Do you have any ideas on this work?
language English<asr_text>In my opinion, it has a broad prospect and it needs smart mind.
language English<asr_text>Good!
language English<asr_text>Good coming, sir. What can I do for you?
language English<asr_text>Good coming. I would like to open a new account. I want to deposit five hundred dollars.
language English<asr_text>Very good, sir. What kind would you like?
language English<asr_text>Could you tell me how many kinds there are in your bank?
language English<asr_text>Besides the checking account, there's a monthly savings account and a daily interest account.
language English<asr_text>Oh, I think I'd like to take the monthly savings account then.
language English<asr_text>Would you fill out this form?
language English<asr_text>OK. Here you are.
language English<asr_text>All right. And here's your deposit book.
language English<asr_text>Thank you. Goodbye.
language English<asr_text>Goodbye.
language English<asr_text>Why don't we get ourselves a new car? The old one's falling apart.
language English<asr_text>What a good idea!
language English<asr_text>What kind shall we get?
language English<asr_text>We could go to more places this time, if you liked.
language English<asr_text>Yes, fine.
language English<asr_text>When shall we go and look?
language English<asr_text>Why not sometime next week?
language English<asr_text>No, let's go on Saturday.
language English<asr_text>OK.
language English<asr_text>Where shall we go?
language English<asr_text>There's a car dealer down the road. How about going there?
language English<asr_text>No, I don't like that place. Why don't we try the garage Martin recommended?
language English<asr_text>Fine, We'll do that.
language English<asr_text>Hello. Good morning, Stately Restaurant. May I help you?
language English<asr_text>I would like to book a table for seven thirty o'clock, please.
language English<asr_text>Fine, sir. For how many people, please?
language English<asr_text>For four people. We'd like a quiet table with a fine view of the river.
language English<asr_text>OK. What name, please?
language English<asr_text>This is Peter Kaufman.
language English<asr_text>Can you spell that, please?
language English<asr_text>Peter Kaufman, P-E-T-E-R ( Peter ), K-A-U-F-M-A-N ( Kaufman ).
language English<asr_text>Oh, thanks, Mr. Kaufman. We look forward to your visit.
language English<asr_text>Bye-bye.
language English<asr_text>Guess who I saw just now?
language English<asr_text>Who?
language English<asr_text>John Smith, the escaped criminal.
language English<asr_text>That bad egg, who took the low road since he was a boy.
language English<asr_text>I think I must report to the cops.
language English<asr_text>OK.
language English<asr_text>We can't go that way, the road is blocked for the next few days.
language English<asr_text>Oh, that's right. They're filming a movie up there, aren't they?
language English<asr_text>Some high speed chase scene, I think.
language English<asr_text>I wonder how all the businesses in the area feel about it.
language English<asr_text>I think that they get a pretty good payoff.
language English<asr_text>The movie company has to pay them?
language English<asr_text>I don't know about all of that, but think about it, their business gets free publicity!
language English<asr_text>Oh, yeah, they get to be in a movie for the whole world to see!
language English<asr_text>What kind of jobs have you had?
language English<asr_text>I have been a Production Manager.
language English<asr_text>How many years have you worked as a Production Manager?
language English<asr_text>Three years.
language English<asr_text>Would you like to tell me something about your outstanding achievements?
language English<asr_text>I had introduced an advanced product line, which increased the output and lessened the cost.
language English<asr_text>Wonderful. Then how many employers have you worked for?
language English<asr_text>Frankly speaking, three. If your company employs me, it will be my fourth.
language English<asr_text>Then have you received any award at your present company?
language English<asr_text>Yes. I was awarded the title of Advanced Worker last year.
language English<asr_text>How would you evaluate the company you are with?
language English<asr_text>Although I could not say that everything is perfect there, I still very much appreciate what the company has given me, especially many chances.
language English<asr_text>How would your colleagues evaluate you?
language English<asr_text>They would say I am a responsible friend and a capable colleague.
language English<asr_text>Umm can you get recommendations from your present employers?
language English<asr_text>Yes, I have brought them with me. Here they are.
language English<asr_text>Do you have any questions?
language English<asr_text>I think that you have covered all the important points already. But if I have any questions later I will contact you.
language English<asr_text>My child is often absent-minded in class.
language English<asr_text>It's all right. Kids are like that.
language English<asr_text>But if he doesn't listen to the teacher carefully, he won't learn anything.
language English<asr_text>Umm, don't worry. His teacher will tell him to be good.
language English<asr_text>I hope so.
language English<asr_text>Is this the Central Park to East Market bus?
language English<asr_text>This is the East Market to Central Park bus. Where do you want to go?
language English<asr_text>To the Municipal Government Hall.
language English<asr_text>Take the same number bus going in the other direction. There's a stop right across the street.
language English<asr_text>Thank you.
language English<asr_text>This broth is wonderful. What's in it?
language English<asr_text>Lamb and beef. It will get even tastier when we add the veggies!
language English<asr_text>Hey! Watch out! You're using the same spoon for both broths!
language English<asr_text>So?
language English<asr_text>You're getting that hot stuff in my mild broth!
language English<asr_text>You'll be OK. It's just a little bit...
language English<asr_text>I wonder if we can change to Channel five.
language English<asr_text>Why?
language English<asr_text>I want to know what's on that channel.
language English<asr_text>Oh, good.
language English<asr_text>There is a football match.
language English<asr_text>I prefer TV play to football.
language English<asr_text>OK. Could you turn it down?
language English<asr_text>What are you going to do?
language English<asr_text>I'm going to listen to the radio.
language English<asr_text>Maybe we can enjoy the TV play together. It's interesting.
language English<asr_text>May I help you? Miss!
language English<asr_text>Yes. I'd like to look at lipstick and eye shadow.
language English<asr_text>What color set do you prefer?
language English<asr_text>Well, brown.
language English<asr_text>We have a beautiful selection of eye shadows this fall. Umm look at the colors. Aren't they beautiful?
language English<asr_text>But they're purple. I prefer a brown set.
language English<asr_text>If you insist, I can show you the brown sets. I'll have to warn you that they're very ordinary, though.
language English<asr_text>Well, I'm not so sure. Most of my make-up is brown.
language English<asr_text>Why don't you wear purple eye shadow for a change? We also have lipstick to go with it.
language English<asr_text>Can I try it?
language English<asr_text>Sure. Are you wearing any make-up?
language English<asr_text>No.
language English<asr_text>Have a seat, please. Now, here is the mirror. How do you like it?
language English<asr_text>Not bad. Actually, it makes me look younger. I like it.
language English<asr_text>Try the lipstick as well. See, how fresh and charming you look.
language English<asr_text>You're right. I'll take them all.
language English<asr_text>Kathy! How are you? It's been ages! What are you doing these days?
language English<asr_text>I just opened my own restaurant. I'm also head chef.
language English<asr_text>You're kidding! You've always hated cooking!
language English<asr_text>Well, I used to hate cooking, but now I love it.
language English<asr_text>When did you change your mind?
language English<asr_text>After I tried French food. Before that, I used to cook really boring things for my family.
language English<asr_text>I still can't believe it! So, did you go to cooking school or something?
language English<asr_text>Yeah. I went to California to study.
language English<asr_text>Really? How long did you stay there?
language English<asr_text>I was there between eighty eight and ninety.
language English<asr_text>And what did you do after that?
language English<asr_text>Then I came back here. I worked for about three years to get some experience.
language English<asr_text>Good morning, Madam. What can I do for you?
language English<asr_text>Can you show me some traditional Chinese arts and crafts?
language English<asr_text>Maybe sandalwood fan is good.
language English<asr_text>Would you show me some?
language English<asr_text>Of course.
language English<asr_text>They really smell fragrant. How much is a real sandalwood fan?
language English<asr_text>The small ones are one hundred yuan for each. And the big ones are two hundred and thirty yuan.
language English<asr_text>I'll take two small ones and a big one.
language English<asr_text>What else are you interested in?
language English<asr_text>I'm afraid not.
language English<asr_text>OK. Here you are.
language English<asr_text>Well, this is not quite the style I want. Do you have any suit in fashion?
language English<asr_text>How is this one? It's the latest, made of cashmere.
language English<asr_text>Can I try it on?
language English<asr_text>Sure.
language English<asr_text>Umm, this is much better. How much is it?
language English<asr_text>I am really impressed with your presentation skills.
language English<asr_text>Thank you. I have been working on it for several years.
language English<asr_text>Well, your time has been well spent!
language English<asr_text>It also helps that I have strong team members, such as yourself. You really know your stuff!
language English<asr_text>Thanks, but I have to admit I am really good at bluffing!
language English<asr_text>What can I do for you?
language English<asr_text>I wish to buy a diamond ring.
language English<asr_text>How many carats diamond do you want?
language English<asr_text>Two carats.
language English<asr_text>Is this one suit for you?
language English<asr_text>No, it seems too old-fashioned.
language English<asr_text>What about this?
language English<asr_text>Let me try it on, it's too small for me, haven't you got any larger ones?
language English<asr_text>Yes, try this one please.
language English<asr_text>Umm….This fits me well, how much is it?
language English<asr_text>Thirty five hundred yuan.
language English<asr_text>It's reasonable. Here you are.
language English<asr_text>So, Paula, where are you from?
language English<asr_text>I'm from Canada, originally.
language English<asr_text>From Canada? Where were you born?
language English<asr_text>Montreal.
language English<asr_text>When did you come to Los Angeles?
language English<asr_text>We moved here when I was fourteen.
language English<asr_text>Did you go to school here?
language English<asr_text>Well, I went to high school here, but I went to college in Texas.
language English<asr_text>Did you get a job right after graduation?
language English<asr_text>No, I traveled for a while in Europe after college, and then I lived in France.
language English<asr_text>When was that?
language English<asr_text>Let's see... That was about six years ago.
language English<asr_text>I bet that was interesting. What did you do there?
language English<asr_text>I studied French. Anyway... that's enough about me.How about you? Were you born in L. A.?
language English<asr_text>Are you ready for your first driving lesson?
language English<asr_text>Yes. Which one is the brake again?
language English<asr_text>The pedal on your left is the brake and the one on your right is the gas.
language English<asr_text>I’m glad this car is an automatic. Umm I don't like having to change gears.
language English<asr_text>Automatics are very simple to drive. The first thing you should do is put your seat belt on.
language English<asr_text>You should also put yours on. You never know what will happen with me in the driver’s seat!
language English<asr_text>Very funny. Next you should check your side mirrors and your rear view mirror. Can you see out of them?
language English<asr_text>I can’t see anything out of the side mirror on your side of the car. Could you move it forward a bit, please?
language English<asr_text>How’s that?
language English<asr_text>That’s better. Now what?
language English<asr_text>Check your petrol situation.
language English<asr_text>The tank is almost empty. I guess I’ll drive to the petrol station to fill it up.
language English<asr_text>That’s a good idea. Put your keys in the ignition, start it up, put the car in reserve, wait for the road to be clear, and then back out of the driveway.
language English<asr_text>I got it. Don’t worry. I’ll get you there in one piece.
language English<asr_text>Remember, no honking this time. The horn is only for emergencies!

language English<asr_text>Come on in. Let me show you the house. Isn't it something?
language English<asr_text>Spacious, bright and clean. And the walls were newly painted.
language English<asr_text>Have you ever seen such a nice house?
language English<asr_text>Not really.
language English<asr_text>This is the kitchen. Everything's new.
language English<asr_text>It's great!

language English<asr_text>And your name, please?
language English<asr_text>Sophie Anderson.
language English<asr_text>Yes, ma'am. You're booked on Flight two-o-one, leaving in an hour.
language English<asr_text>Thank you.

language English<asr_text>What do you do there?
language English<asr_text>Mostly office work - filing and so on.

language English<asr_text>Till the end of the month.

language English<asr_text>All right. Come with me, please. Here is your seat, ma'am. Would you like to order now?
language English<asr_text>Yes.
language English<asr_text>What would you like for a drink?
language English<asr_text>Wine, please.
language English<asr_text>What kind?
language English<asr_text>Something real Australian.
language English<asr_text>Would Chablis be all right?
language English<asr_text>Yes. That would be fine.

language English<asr_text>I'll have Chicken and Ginger Burger with Chilli Dressing.

language English<asr_text>If you think it's expensive. You can look at this one.

language English<asr_text>Let me see.

language English<asr_text>No, I'm open to suggestions.
language English<asr_text>Why don't you visit the Great Wall first?
language English<asr_text>That's a good idea.
language English<asr_text>Here we are. That will be seven yuan and seventy cents.
language English<asr_text>Thanks a lot. Here's ten yuan. Keep the change.
language English<asr_text>The Johnson are on their way back. You remember them, don't you?
language English<asr_text>Johnson? Umm I can't place them.
language English<asr_text>We met them in Bermuda last May.
language English<asr_text>They've completely slipped my mind.
language English<asr_text>The couple with the dogs, think back.
